## Two more spec-18 member lines for this card's mirror alignment · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z` · 2026-10-14T04:46Z

Found by the contract review `6161068462` of objectui PR #12350 (objectui#12270), and recorded in that PR's ACCEPT `6161097655` with this card as the carrier. Neither line was filed as a card of its own.

Spec 18's `EmptyStateSchema` has four members, and `link` is the new one. Two `@object-ui/types`-side sentences still name three:

- **`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:783`** (at `f20667b0e`): the `object-grid` `emptyState` describe reads `{ title, message, icon }`. The schema itself takes the spec's `EmptyStateSchema` by reference, so only the text lags.
- **`apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`**, in the `MEMBER_PINS` row `object-grid.emptyState`: "All three members the spec's strict `EmptyStateSchema` declares". It stays mechanically green, because the check reads only that the pin file names the block and the key. The `link` member's pin is `ObjectGrid.emptyStateLink-12270.test.tsx`.

This card already aligns the `@object-ui/types` mirror with spec 18's members, so when it is dispatched, these two sentences belong to the same sweep.

## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T05:53Z

Read fresh, with the comment `6161115787`, and checked on objectui `main` `b9814b334d`:
- `RecordDetailsComponentProps` (`packages/types/src/record-components.ts:101`) declares `showBorder` (`:202`) and no `hideEmpty`;
- `objectql.zod.ts:783` still describes `emptyState` as `{ title, message, icon }`;
- `@objectstack/spec` declares the detail section's `hideEmpty` (`packages/spec/src/shared/section-group-reference.ts:28` on `main`).

The card holds.
- **The ruling of record is not #7129 Q1-A.** The director's dated note on #7129 (`5689202985`) records it superseded for `hideEmpty` by the batch #137 item 3 ruling on objectui#8603: spec 17.3.0+ declares the key, and objectui follows the protocol. Aligning the types mirror carries that ruling out. **No new decision is owed.**
- **Clause ②:** `no` for objectui. The accept set was widened by the spec, and the mirror only follows it, so no new spec-lane act.
- **`priority:p2`.** A spec-valid section fails to type-check on a published face (`@object-ui/types`), which authors and AI write against. There is no runtime harm: the renderer already honours the key. No `target:` label, because it is not a v18 break; the gap dates from spec 17.3.
- **Scope:** the `sections[]` members, `hideEmpty` included, plus the #8583 pin extension, plus the two `EmptyStateSchema` sentences from `6161115787` (the `objectql.zod.ts:783` describe and the `MEMBER_PINS` row's "three members").
